user_request: 那我们是不是可以按照新的相位估计进行SNR实验的500场景
first_input: One new input first, retained in the 3000; then four workers.
rules: Runtime failure stops dispatch and drains running work.
Truth is used only after prediction for scoring.
All outputs and references re-scored and hashed at finalization.
limitations: First 500 scenes include development scenes; not an untouched holdout.
The remaining 487 scenes were not used in this finite phase selection, but may occur in prior research.
Known-phase reference uses supplied true phase in its operator and is explicitly labeled.
Different stopping rules are not equal-compute comparisons; concurrent wall time is not a speed benchmark.
